title: I finally made my childhood dream anime game!
author: Class_Muted
selftext:
Hey guys  
I've been following your creations for a while and I have to say you guys inspired me to finally get into making games with AI and make my childhood dreams come true!

I've been working on my dream anime fighting game, Jump Impact, for the past few weeks. And it's finally at a level i'm comfortable with showing it to people. I've posted a few tweets about it and the reactions have been overwhelmingly positive with people reaching out to set up discord servers and asking to help out with the game cause it's their childhood dream too!  
  
So it finally gave me the courage to share the game here with you guys as well. Would love to hear what you all think and what feedback or tips you have for me!

The project started with GPT 5.6 Sol, made some improvements when GPT-6 Astra came around, but the real magic happened after Opus 5.5 dropped! I've been running 5 Claude Max 20x subs + 1 GPT Pro 20x subs non-stop for the past 2 weeks to get the game to the level it is at now. Plus some help from Meshy and Tripo for the models and rigging.

My goal is to add characters from ALL animes I've watched to the game eventually. I'll be dropping the game tomorrow in case anyone here is interested.

Cheers

If you want to see more footage:  
[Gameplay Footage Tweet](https://x.com/0xArvn/status/2107850400892432498?s=20) \- [20 New characters Added Tweet](https://x.com/0xArvn/status/2106404722697789567?s=20)

comments.author: No-Volume6352
comments.body:
I'm not against using AI. I see vibecoding as just programming in natural language.

I also feel that creative wall and lack of freedom in the fact that "IP" belongs to authors and corporations — there's simply no room to move there.

But Naruto and One Piece aren't your works.

No matter how hard you grind, burning through expensive AI tokens like this, it ultimately won't lead to a good result.

You skipped the most important step before starting your project: creating your own work, your own world, your own characters. You've misbuttoned the very first button, so no matter how appealing a game you end up making, you'll never escape AI slop. Best of luck.

replies.author: Class_Muted
replies.body:
Hey man  
I agree with your points.

Even this game started as an original, anime-style inspired fighting game at first (that game has also been developed in parallel, IS the original base game, and is at the exact same stage as this one, just with original characters)  
But seeing my favorite characters that I grew up watching and rooting for day in and day out as a kid crossover and fight and interact with each other in a game is too happy of a dream for me to pass on, and I won't feel guilty for it even if people call it "AI Slop". I'm not monetizing this game whatsoever, so who am I hurting here exactly? Mega corporations that are earning billions off of these games because me and people like me have been lifelong fans and supporting them and buying their merchandise for decades? Doesn't make sense to me.

And I've been a builder for the past 12 years of my life, building stuff that thousands have used over the years to make their life easier. I'm pretty familiar with creating stuff from scratch but the fact that you can just realize your own and others childhood dreams in your leisure time using AI is a luxury that I would take advantage of every day of the week.
